findings.title: Managers cannot see cancellation notes beyond the first 200 detail rows — the table silently slices the filtered results without pagination
findings.observed: A 201-row result displays only 200 rows while the footer says 201 lines.

findings.title: Managers export other cancellation rows instead of their selected scope and filters — Cancellations exports the unfiltered dataset
findings.observed: The Order-Level or filtered table exports all cancellation rows and unfiltered totals.

findings.title: A second user can see the previous outlet's cancellation notes after sign-out — an in-flight report repopulates the cleared cache and all report callers use restaurant id 0
findings.observed: An old in-flight response can be cached after logout and reused under the next user's session.

findings.title: Managers lose legacy cancellation notes on Item Cancellation Detail — its Note cell reads only cancel_item_note, not the notes fallback used by Cancellations
findings.observed: A row with notes set and an empty cancel_item_note shows — on detail and exports no note.

findings.title: Managers' Cancellations downloads omit legacy notes visible on screen — the Note export column uses cancelItemNote without the notes fallback
findings.observed: When only notes is set, the table shows it but Excel and PDF export an empty Note.

findings.title: Managers see cancellation reasons in the unrelated Order Note Audit instead of food preparation notes — the audit prioritizes cancel_item_note over notes
findings.observed: When both fields are populated, the Notes column shows cancel_item_note and hides notes.

findings.title: Managers cannot read long cancellation notes on touch devices — both report tables truncate notes and expose the remainder only through a hover title
findings.observed: Long notes are truncated at 160px or 200px with no touch-accessible expansion.

findings.title: Managers lose their selected report date range on reload — the shared range is initialized to today in memory only
findings.observed: Reload resets a previously applied historical range to today's date on both reports.

findings.title: Managers cannot open the cancellation spreadsheets as the required XLSX files — the shared exporter writes legacy SpreadsheetML with an .xls extension
findings.observed: Download as Excel saves an XML-based .xls rather than an .xlsx workbook.

findings.title: Managers do not receive a PDF when downloading either report — the PDF action opens HTML and invokes print instead of creating a PDF file
findings.observed: Download as PDF opens an HTML print window and never generates or downloads a .pdf.

findings.title: Managers on phones cannot reach all Item Cancellation Detail columns — the eight-column table is clipped by an overflow-hidden container without horizontal scrolling
findings.observed: The Note, By and Timing columns overflow the clipped table at narrow viewport widths.

findings.title: Managers unknowingly inspect the previous financial year when choosing FY — the preset subtracts a year from the current fiscal-year start
findings.observed: In November 2026 FY selects 2025-04-01 through 2026-03-31, not the current FY.
